query:
SELECT c.id            AS "channel_id!",
                   COALESCE(t.name, '') AS "team_name!",
                   u.locale        AS "user_locale!",
                   u.username      AS "username!"
              FROM posts p
              JOIN channels c ON p.channelid = c.id
              LEFT JOIN teams t ON c.teamid = t.id
              JOIN users u ON p.userid = u.id
             WHERE p.id = $1
